Xech- Arc Bluetooth Speaker with Mobile and Pen Holder – Smart Sound for Work & Play

The Xech- Arc Bluetooth Speaker with Mobile and Pen Holder is a modern, multifunctional audio solution designed for people who value productivity, portability, and premium sound quality. Combining a Bluetooth Speaker, mobile stand, and dual pen holder in one compact form, this speaker is ideal for offices, study desks, home setups, and travel. With powerful audio output, intuitive controls, and a sleek seamless flap design, it enhances both your workspace and entertainment experience.

Powered by a high-efficiency 5W Speaker, the Xech- Arc delivers crisp highs, balanced mids, and rich bass that fills the room despite its compact size. Whether you are attending virtual meetings, streaming music, watching videos, or taking hands-free calls, the front-facing sound ensures clear and immersive audio at all times. The built-in inbuilt microphone makes it perfect for conference calls and online classes without needing additional accessories.

Designed for Everyday Convenience

More than just a wireless speaker, this device is thoughtfully engineered to support your daily routine. The integrated mobile stand allows you to place your smartphone securely at an ideal viewing angle, while the two pen stand holders keep your desk organized and clutter-free. The heavy duty lanyard adds portability, making it easy to carry or hang wherever you go.

Advanced Wireless Performance

Experience seamless wireless connectivity with advanced Bluetooth technology that ensures stable pairing and low latency. The TWS pairing feature allows you to connect two compatible speakers for a true stereo experience, delivering wider soundstage and enhanced volume. With one click unpair functionality, switching devices is quick and hassle-free.

Long Battery Life with Fast Charging

The Xech- Arc is equipped with a powerful battery up to 6H play time, allowing you to enjoy uninterrupted music or calls throughout the day. Thanks to fast charging technology, just 15 min charge provides 1 hour of play time, ensuring your speaker is always ready when you need it. The modern USB Type-C charging port ensures faster, safer, and more reliable power delivery.

Premium Build & User-Friendly Controls

Crafted with durability in mind, the speaker features a robust body with a seamless flap design that enhances both aesthetics and usability. The front facing controls make it easy to adjust volume, manage playback, and answer calls without reaching around the device. Every detail is designed to deliver a smooth and intuitive user experience.

Key Features & Specifications

  • 5W high-performance Bluetooth Speaker with clear and balanced sound
  • Integrated mobile stand for hands-free viewing
  • Two pen stand holders for desk organization
  • TWS pairing for immersive stereo sound
  • USB Type-C charging for fast and reliable power
  • Powerful battery up to 6 hours of play time
  • 15 minutes of charge delivers up to 1 hour of playback
  • Inbuilt microphone for hands-free calling and meetings
  • One click unpair for easy device switching
  • Front facing controls for effortless operation
  • Seamless flap design with premium finish
  • Heavy duty lanyard for portability and convenience

Ideal for Multiple Use Cases

Whether you are a professional working from home, a student attending online classes, or a music lover who values compact yet powerful audio, the Xech- Arc Bluetooth Speaker fits perfectly into your lifestyle. Its multifunctional design makes it an excellent choice for desks, bedside tables, kitchens, and travel bags.

Upgrade your audio experience with a smart, stylish, and efficient solution. The combines powerful sound, thoughtful design, and everyday practicality—making it a must-have accessory for modern users.
